meta.topic: 라면 물 550ml 완벽 조절을 위한 궁극의 시스템
meta.top_title: 라면 물 조절 실패하는 사람 필독
meta.source_script: (벤치마킹 원본: 우산을 써도 다리가 젖는 사소한 불편 -> 과도한 공학 장치를 하나씩 추가 -> 결국 거대 기계 완성 -> 원래 문제로 회귀하는 허무한 클로징)

analysis.hook_technique: "우산을 써도 다리가 젖는다"는 100% 공감 가능한 사소한 불편으로 1초 만에 시선 확보
analysis.retention_psychology: 해결 장치를 하나 더할 때마다 새 문제가 생기는 점진적 과장(Escalation)을 극도로 진지한 톤으로 전개
analysis.skeleton: [사소한 불편] → [과도한 공학 장치 1] → [파생 문제 해결 장치 2] → [거대 기계 완성] → [원래 문제로 회귀하는 허무한 반전]

titles: 라면 물 550ml 칼같이 맞추려다 공장을 지어버린 사람
라면 물 조절 실패하는 사람들을 위한 최종 병기
물 1방울 오차도 용납 못 하는 이과생의 라면 끓이기
plan.description: 라면 끓일 때마다 한강물 만들던 분들 주목하세요. 오차 0.01ml 이하의 유체역학 라면 조리 시스템입니다.

beats: 라면 끓일 때마다 물 맞추기 실패한다면
scenes.frame1: medium macro shot of the male PVC figure staring blankly at a miniature silver pot overflowing with clear water on a tiny kitchen counter
scenes.frame2: low-angle shot of a miniature stainless steel IV drip regulator with precision brass dials clamping onto the pot rim

cuts.prompt: Rapid push-in zoom toward the plastic figure's disappointed deadpan face above the flooded pot
A mechanical steel clamp snaps securely onto the pot rim with brass valves gleaming under a spotlight, micro-camera shake on impact
A single water droplet drips slowly through a clear glass chamber, sharp freeze at 7.5s

scenes.frame1: medium shot of heavy miniature hydraulic tubes and an industrial steel pump humming beside the small pot, metallic reflections
scenes.frame2: Dutch angle wide shot of the miniature kitchen counter cracking and tilting downward under immense heavy machinery weight

cuts.prompt: Fast tracking shot along high-pressure hydraulic pipes pulsing with subtle mechanical vibration
The miniature counter buckles with a sharp downward tilt, plaster dust falling, dynamic camera shake on impact
Fast whip-pan upward to the PVC figure standing rigidly with hands on hips, head tilted in disbelief, freeze at 7.5s

beats: 붕괴를 막으려 바닥에 철골 기둥을 세우고
scenes.frame1: low-angle shot of sturdy red industrial H-beam miniature steel pillars supporting the cracked counter from below
scenes.frame2: medium close-up of a ceiling-mounted miniature laser emitter projecting a glowing circular grid downward onto the pot surface

cuts.prompt: Smooth upward tilt tracking the heavy red steel support beams holding the sagging structure
A sleek laser sensor rotates smoothly, firing an intricate grid pattern downward into the pot
Snappy whip-pan downward to the boiling water surface illuminated in green laser light, crisp freeze at 7.5s

scenes.frame1: medium shot of a massive spherical glass condenser dome descending mechanically over the bubbling pot, frosty white vapor curling
scenes.frame2: medium close-up of a tiny glowing cyan liquid droplet falling into a calibrated glass chamber, soft rim lighting

cuts.prompt: Dramatic camera rush down as the glass condensation dome clamps tightly over the boiling steam
A single droplet falls in ultra-slow motion with water ripple physics, glowing softly
Snappy whip-pan to an automated mechanical valve hissing open, releasing a burst of cooling mist, sharp freeze at 7.5s

beats: 문제는 기계에서 나오는 열기 때문에 방 안 온도가
scenes.frame1: eye-level wide shot of the entire kitchen transformed into a sprawling industrial chemical plant diorama, glowing orange heat aura
scenes.frame2: close-up of the male PVC figure sweating painted sweat droplets, holding chopsticks weakly in the melting kitchen diorama

cuts.prompt: Cinematic slow pull-back revealing the ridiculously oversized industrial piping filling the tiny apartment kitchen
Heat haze ripples across the camera lens, the plastic figure stands dazed in exhaustion
Fast whip-pan downward to chopsticks drooping under the intense heat, sharp snap freeze at 7.5s

beats: 결국 땀 뻘뻘 흘리며 뚜껑을 열었더니
scenes.frame1: medium shot of the PVC figure opening the pot lid, showing completely clear plain water with plain yellow noodles and zero soup broth
scenes.frame2: close-up of an unopened silver seasoning packet resting on the counter while the figure stares directly at camera in frozen despair

cuts.prompt: Camera tracks forward into the pot showing completely pale, clear broth without seasoning
The unopened seasoning packet glints under the lamp while the figure stares deadpan directly into the lens
Snappy push-in zoom toward the figure's unblinking eyes breaking the fourth wall, sudden hard blackout transition at 7.5s
